sources.title: Protogen_v2.2_Official_Release: Image-to-Image model — overview, use ...
sources.snippet: Protogen v2.2 is a text-to-image diffusion model specialized for anime-style artwork generation, maintained by darkstorm2150. The model uses Stable Diffusion v1-5 as its foundation and was fine-tuned on large datasets from civitai.com containing trending anime and illustration styles.
